html:
SMTO-UI-0021 — Open a conversation

GUID: 48d8c019-88e9-4448-a936-12a2fca9d2bb
Slug: ui-conversation-required
Domain: UI · Subsystem: ui

What happened

  • You chose Export, but no saved conversation was open to export, so nothing was downloaded. A new chat isn't saved until you send its first message.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Pick the conversation you want to export from the conversation list and wait for its messages to appear. Export saves the conversation that's open, so one has to be open first.
  2. If you're in a new chat, send at least one message before exporting. A new chat doesn't become a saved conversation until its first message is sent.
  3. Select Export again. On a phone, open the conversation's ⋯ menu in the history list and choose Export conversation. Now the export knows exactly which conversation to download.

What success looks like

  • A conversation-….zip file downloads in your browser.

If it still fails

  • Refresh the browser page, open the conversation again and retry Export. If it still fails, select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Conversation export was requested without a current conversation ID, so no archive request was sent.

What this means

  • Conversation export is requested without a current conversation ID. The shown control rejects this local action before its dependent submission. Earlier requests and saved state are unaffected by this validation result; server-side authority remains authoritative.

Why this can happen

  • Conversation export is requested without a current conversation ID.

How to diagnose it

  • Check the open conversation identity rather than using an unsaved draft as an archive source.

How to fix it

  • download() in conversation_export.js (and the bundled mobile export) throws ui_conversation_required when conversationId is empty, before requesting the archive from the /api/agent/native-conversations export endpoint. Select the intended saved conversation so the Export control is bound to its ID; do not export a different conversation in its place.
  • Open the intended saved conversation before using this action.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • The intended saved conversation is selected and exported through its own control.

What not to do

  • Do not silently substitute a different target for a saved run or move its existing execution authority.

Technical notes

  • The shown control rejects this local action before its dependent submission. Earlier requests and saved state are unaffected by this validation result; server-side authority remains authoritative.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
